compatibility.notes: Public display name Handoff is independent of canonical asset id agent.session-handoff.

do_not_use_when.text: The session produced no consequential changes, decisions, or unresolved work worth preserving
The work is small enough that the next action is obvious without a durable handoff artifact

use_when.text: A substantial work session is ending and verified continuation context must be preserved
Work is being paused with unfinished items, unresolved decisions, or partial validation results
Ownership of the work is transferring to another agent, model, or engineer who must resume without rediscovering state

evidence_outputs.description: Compact handoff artifact with status, completed work, files changed, validation, decisions, and next action.
evidence_outputs.name: handoff_pack

evidence_outputs.description: Concrete next action and first inspection steps.
evidence_outputs.name: continuation_point

inputs.description: Session transcript or notes recording the work actually attempted.
inputs.name: session_transcript

inputs.description: Repository, branch, commit, and working-tree state precise enough to resume safely.
inputs.name: repository_state

inputs.description: Validation performed including failed, skipped, or unavailable checks.
inputs.name: validation_results

inputs.description: Decisions left open and the exact next action needed to resolve each one.
inputs.name: unresolved_decisions

outputs.description: Status, completed work, files changed, validation, decisions, known issues, immediate next action, and continuation instructions.
outputs.name: handoff_pack

outputs.description: Exact defensible next action with the first files or commands to inspect.
outputs.name: continuation_point

outputs.description: Confirmed, strong signal, reasonable hypothesis, weak signal, and unknown items distinguished.
outputs.name: uncertainty_register

preconditions.description: Session transcript, notes, or repository state is available to summarize.
Current repository, branch, and working-tree state can be inspected precisely.

capability.purpose: Capture enough verified context for another model or later session to continue without repeating discovery work.

requirements.description: Completed work is recorded only when supported by repository state or validation evidence.
Failed tests, skipped checks, and dirty working-tree state are disclosed rather than hidden.
The continuation point names the exact next action and the first files or commands to inspect.
Confirmed, strong signal, reasonable hypothesis, weak signal, and unknown items are separated.
